hero.title: Village Development and Environmental Initiatives
hero.description: Special Gram Panchayat initiatives for sustainable development, environmental protection and modern village facilities.

intro.title: Towards a Prosperous Village Through Nature Conservation
intro.description: Protecting the environment is essential while working towards the overall development of a village. Initiatives such as tree plantation, cleanliness, water conservation, renewable energy and digital literacy can help build a clean, green and sustainable village.

message.title: Protect Nature, Develop the Village
message.description: A clean, green and well-equipped village can be built through community participation and collective efforts. Environment-friendly actions today lay the foundation for a safer tomorrow.

activities.title: Key Initiatives for Village Development
activities.description: Initiatives that encourage environmental protection, cleanliness, conservation of natural resources and the use of modern technology.

treePlantation.title: Tree Plantation Campaign
treePlantation.description: Increase green cover and maintain environmental balance in the village. Encourage every family to plant at least one tree through the 'One Home – One Tree' concept.

cleanliness.title: Waste Segregation and Management
cleanliness.description: Promote separate collection and proper management of wet and dry waste. Encourage composting of wet waste and create awareness among citizens to keep the village clean.

waterConservation.title: Water Conservation and Management
waterConservation.description: Create awareness about responsible water use, rainwater harvesting and the protection of available water resources.

renewableEnergy.title: Solar and Renewable Energy
renewableEnergy.description: Promote solar energy to reduce electricity consumption and support environment-friendly lighting. Encourage the use of solar street lights on major roads and at public junctions.

greenery.title: Green and Plastic-Free Village
greenery.description: Reduce the use of single-use plastics and encourage environment-friendly alternatives such as reusable cloth bags.

awareness.title: Environmental Awareness and Digital Literacy
awareness.description: Build awareness among citizens about environmental protection, cleanliness and the use of modern technology. Encourage young people and women to develop computer and internet skills.

commitment.title: Gram Panchayat's Commitment to Sustainable Development
commitment.description: The objective is to promote sustainable village development through initiatives in cleanliness, tree conservation, water conservation, renewable energy and digital literacy. Active participation from village residents is essential to these efforts.

environment.greenFutureDescription: Collective efforts towards a clean, beautiful and environment-friendly village.
